Built by Donald McKay and launched in 1853 in East Boston, the clipper ship
"Great Republic"
was the summit of achievement in the world of sailing ships.
She was, from the standpoint of size, appearance and cost... the King of Clippers.
The "Great Republic"
was considered
icent craft ever produced by any nation or age.
the largest, sharpest and most magnif
Before she had barely tasted
salt water, fire broke out in her New
York wharf, and within minutes the "Great
Republic" was a network of flames. She was later rebuilt but with her tonnage,
sail plan and spars reduced.
Like Pan Am's modern Clippers® of the air, the early clipper ships traveled the
lanes of commerce to all far places of the world. Pan Am's Clipper fleet of the
20th Century
consists
the
finest commercial aircraft
ever developed...
Clippers that helped Pan Am establish an unparalleled record for safety, speed
and service.
